जो समय की कद्र करना सीख जाता है, समय एक दिन उसकी कद्र करवाता है

(Multiple Choice Q & A)
--------------------------------------

1 .Who has been nominated as the next Chairperson of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)?
भारतीय दिवाला और शोधन अक्षमता बोर्ड (IBBI) का अगला अध्यक्ष किसे नामित किया गया है?
Answer: Rahul Madan / राहुल मदान

2 .Who has been elected as the President of the 100th Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan?
100वें अखिल भारतीय मराठी साहित्य सम्मेलन का अध्यक्ष किसे चुना गया है?
Answer: Dr. Sharan Kumar Limbale / डॉ. शरण कुमार लिंबाले

3 .Which three banks have retained Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB) status in the RBI's 2026 list?
RBI की वर्ष 2026 की सूची में किन तीन बैंकों ने घरेलू प्रणालीगत रूप से महत्वपूर्ण बैंक (D-SIB) का दर्जा बरकरार रखा है?
Answer: SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank / एसबीआई, एचडीएफसी बैंक और आईसीआईसीआई बैंक

4 .Which new name for the state has recently been approved by the West Bengal Cabinet?
पश्चिम बंगाल मंत्रिमंडल ने हाल ही में राज्य के किस नए नाम को मंजूरी दी है?
Answer: Paschim Banga / पश्चिम बंग

5 .In which city is the historic Bali Jatra Festival recently being held?
हाल ही मे ऐतिहासिक बाली जात्रा महोत्सव का आयोजन किस शहर में किया जा रहा है?
Answer: Cuttack, Odisha / कटक, ओडिशा

6 .The Manjeera River, recently in the news due to water pollution, is a tributary of which river?
जल प्रदूषण के कारण हाल ही में चर्चा में रही मंजीरा नदी किस नदी की सहायक नदी है?
Answer: Godavari River / गोदावरी नदी

7 .In which city will the 65th Annual Conference of the Indian Society of Aerospace Medicine (ISAM) be held?
इंडियन सोसाइटी ऑफ एयरोस्पेस मेडिसिन (ISAM) के 65वें वार्षिक सम्मेलन का आयोजन किस शहर में किया जाएगा?
Answer: Bengaluru / बेंगलुरु

8 .Which city will host the sixth season of the Pro Wrestling League in January 2027?
जनवरी 2027 में प्रो रेसलिंग लीग के छठे सीजन की मेजबानी कौन-सा शहर करेगा?
Answer: New Delhi / नई दिल्ली

9 .Which birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji was celebrated on 24 November 2026?
24 नवंबर 2026 को गुरु नानक देव जी की कौन-सी जयंती मनाई गई?
Answer: 557th birth anniversary / 557वीं जयंती

10 .Who won the first prize in Prasar Bharati's first 'Page to Pitch' screenplay competition at IFFI 2026?
IFFI 2026 में प्रसार भारती की पहली 'पेज से पिच तक' पटकथा प्रतियोगिता में प्रथम पुरस्कार किसने जीता?
Answer: Avishesh Jha / अविशेष झा

11 .For which screenplay did Avishesh Jha win the first prize at 'Page to Pitch' 2026?
'पेज से पिच तक' 2026 में अविशेष झा ने किस पटकथा के लिए प्रथम पुरस्कार जीता?
Answer: Mirchi Cake / मिर्ची केक

12 .In which city was the 54th International Emmy Awards 2026 held?
54वें अंतरराष्ट्रीय एमी पुरस्कार 2026 का आयोजन किस शहर में किया गया?
Answer: New York City, USA / न्यूयॉर्क शहर, अमेरिका

13 .Who won the Best Actor award at the 54th International Emmy Awards 2026?
54वें अंतरराष्ट्रीय एमी पुरस्कार 2026 में सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता का पुरस्कार किसने जीता?
Answer: Bobby Schofield / बॉबी स्कोफील्ड

The Hindu Vocabulary 

1. Ramifications (Noun)
Meaning: The complex or unwelcome consequences of an action or event.
Hindi: परिणाम, जटिलताएँ।
Synonyms: Consequences, repercussions, outcomes.
Antonyms: Causes, origins, sources.
Example: Getting rid of all mosquitoes could have major ecological ramifications.
Related Words: Ramify (verb).

2. Futile (Adjective)
Meaning: Incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.
Hindi: व्यर्थ, निरर्थक।
Synonyms: Vain, fruitless, useless.
Antonyms: Effective, fruitful, useful.
Example: Some scientists believe using only insecticides to eradicate mosquitoes is futile due to their adaptability.
Related Words: Futility (noun), futilely (adverb).

3. Bonhomie (Noun)
Meaning: Cheerful friendliness; geniality.
Hindi: मिलनसारिता, खुशमिज़ाजी।
Synonyms: Conviviality, affability, geniality.
Antonyms: Hostility, animosity, coldness.
Example: A rate cut depends on how the renewed bonhomie between India and the U.S. progresses.
Related Words: N/A.

4. Disparagingly (Adverb)
Meaning: In a way that expresses criticism or a low opinion.
Hindi: अपमानजनक ढंग से।
Synonyms: Derogatorily, contemptuously, scornfully.
Antonyms: Respectfully, admiringly, complimentary.
Example: The article talks disparagingly about India, stating it stood nowhere in the race between China and the U.S..
Related Words: Disparage (verb), disparaging (adjective).

5. Phalanx (Noun)
Meaning: A group of people standing or moving forward closely together.
Hindi: व्यूह, दल।
Synonyms: Formation, legion, cohort.
Antonyms: Scattering, individual.
Example: India, China, and Russia constitute a strong phalanx against those wanting to disrupt the world order.
Related Words: N/A.

6. Ephemeral (Adjective)
Meaning: Lasting for a very short time.
Hindi: क्षणिक, अल्पकालिक।
Synonyms: Transitory, fleeting, short-lived.
Antonyms: Permanent, enduring, everlasting.
Example: The U.S.'s current lead in technology is, at best, ephemeral.
Related Words: Ephemerally (adverb), ephemerality (noun).

7. Crucible (Noun)
Meaning: A situation of severe trial, leading to the creation of something new.
Hindi: कठिन परीक्षा, अग्निपरीक्षा।
Synonyms: Trial, ordeal, test, gauntlet.
Antonyms: Comfort, ease, sanctuary.
Example: India's start-up economy is a crucible of global innovation.
Related Words: N/A.

8. Edifices (Noun)
Meaning: Large, imposing buildings or complex structures.
Hindi: भव्य इमारतें, विशाल रचनाएँ।
Synonyms: Structures, monuments, buildings.
Antonyms: Huts, shacks, ruins.
Example: The company's machinery was present at all the major edifices built across the country, like the new Parliament.
Related Words: Edifice (singular noun), edify (verb).

9. Strident (Adjective)
Meaning: Loud and harsh; presenting a point of view in an excessively forceful way.
Hindi: कर्कश, तीखा।
Synonyms: Harsh, raucous, shrill, grating.
Antonyms: Soft, gentle, mellow, soothing.
Example: The Turkish President has criticised Israel with strident rhetoric since the start of the war.
Related Words: Stridently (adverb), stridency (noun).

10. Malady (Noun)
Meaning: A disease, ailment, or serious problem.
Hindi: रोग, व्याधि।
Synonyms: Sickness, illness, affliction.
Antonyms: Health, wellness, remedy.
Example: In 2025, a mysterious malady descended on the village of Turakapalem.
Related Words: N/A.

25 नवम्बर की महत्वपूर्ण घटनाएँ 👉 

• 1867 - अल्फ्रेड नोबेल ने 'डायनामाइट' का पेटेंट कराया।
• 1936 - जर्मनी और जापान ने कम्युनिस्ट इंटरनेशनल के विरुद्ध 'एंटी-कोमिनटर्न समझौते' पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
• 1948 - भारत में राष्ट्रीय कैडेट कोर (NCC) की आधिकारिक स्थापना हुई।
• 1949 - डॉ. भीमराव अंबेडकर ने संविधान सभा में अपना ऐतिहासिक अंतिम भाषण दिया।
• 1960 - टेलीफोन की 'एसटीडी' (STD) सेवा का भारत में पहली बार कानपुर और लखनऊ के बीच प्रयोग किया गया।
• 1975 - दक्षिण अमेरिकी देश सूरीनाम को नीदरलैंड से स्वतंत्रता मिली।
• 2019 - ऑस्ट्रेलिया के तेज गेंदबाज मिशेल स्टार्क ने दिन-रात (पिंक बॉल) टेस्ट क्रिकेट में सबसे तेज़ 200 विकेट लेने का रिकॉर्ड बनाया।
25 नवम्बर को जन्मे प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति 👉

• 1879 - साधु टी.एल. वासवानी (प्रसिद्ध शिक्षाविद, दार्शनिक एवं भारतीय संस्कृति के प्रचारक - इनके जन्मदिन को 'मांस रहित दिवस' के रूप में मनाया जाता है)।
• 1898 - देवकी बोस (भारतीय सिनेमा के प्रसिद्ध फिल्म निर्देशक, लेखक व अभिनेता)।
• 1926 - रंगनाथ मिश्र (भारत के 21वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश एवं राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग के प्रथम अध्यक्ष)।
• 1952 - इमरान खान (विश्व कप विजेता पूर्व पाकिस्तानी क्रिकेट कप्तान एवं पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री)।
• 1982 - झूलन गोस्वामी (भारतीय महिला क्रिकेट टीम की पूर्व कप्तान एवं विश्व की महानतम तेज गेंदबाजों में से एक)।
25 नवम्बर को हुए निधन 👉

• 1974 - यू थान्ट (संयुक्त राष्ट्र के तीसरे महासचिव, बर्मा/म्यांमार से थे)।
• 1975 - चंदूलाल शाह (भारतीय सिनेमा के प्रसिद्ध फिल्म निर्देशक एवं निर्माता)।
• 1984 - यशवंतराव चव्हाण (महाराष्ट्र के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री एवं भारत के पूर्व उप-प्रधानमंत्री)।
• 2016 - फिदेल कास्त्रो (क्यूबा के महान क्रांतिकारी एवं पूर्व राष्ट्रपति)।
• 2020 - डिएगो माराडोना (अर्जेंटीना के विश्व प्रसिद्ध महान फुटबॉल खिलाड़ी)।
• 2020 - अहमद पटेल (वरिष्ठ भारतीय राजनीतिज्ञ एवं पूर्व राज्यसभा सांसद)।
25 नवम्बर के महत्वपूर्ण अवसर एवं उत्सव 👉
• मार्गशीर्ष कृष्ण पक्ष प्रारंभ / रोहिणी व्रत
• अंतर्राष्ट्रीय महिला हिंसा उन्मूलन दिवस
• साधु टी.एल. वासवानी जयंती (मांस रहित दिवस)

📌 INTEGRATION OF PRINCELY STATE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.

The Hindu Vocabulary 

1. Ramifications (Noun)
Meaning: The complex or unwelcome consequences of an action or event.
Hindi: परिणाम, जटिलताएँ।
Synonyms: Consequences, repercussions, outcomes.
Antonyms: Causes, origins, sources.
Example: Getting rid of all mosquitoes could have major ecological ramifications.
Related Words: Ramify (verb).

2. Futile (Adjective)
Meaning: Incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.
Hindi: व्यर्थ, निरर्थक।
Synonyms: Vain, fruitless, useless.
Antonyms: Effective, fruitful, useful.
Example: Some scientists believe using only insecticides to eradicate mosquitoes is futile due to their adaptability.
Related Words: Futility (noun), futilely (adverb).

3. Bonhomie (Noun)
Meaning: Cheerful friendliness; geniality.
Hindi: मिलनसारिता, खुशमिज़ाजी।
Synonyms: Conviviality, affability, geniality.
Antonyms: Hostility, animosity, coldness.
Example: A rate cut depends on how the renewed bonhomie between India and the U.S. progresses.
Related Words: N/A.

4. Disparagingly (Adverb)
Meaning: In a way that expresses criticism or a low opinion.
Hindi: अपमानजनक ढंग से।
Synonyms: Derogatorily, contemptuously, scornfully.
Antonyms: Respectfully, admiringly, complimentary.
Example: The article talks disparagingly about India, stating it stood nowhere in the race between China and the U.S..
Related Words: Disparage (verb), disparaging (adjective).

5. Phalanx (Noun)
Meaning: A group of people standing or moving forward closely together.
Hindi: व्यूह, दल।
Synonyms: Formation, legion, cohort.
Antonyms: Scattering, individual.
Example: India, China, and Russia constitute a strong phalanx against those wanting to disrupt the world order.
Related Words: N/A.

6. Ephemeral (Adjective)
Meaning: Lasting for a very short time.
Hindi: क्षणिक, अल्पकालिक।
Synonyms: Transitory, fleeting, short-lived.
Antonyms: Permanent, enduring, everlasting.
Example: The U.S.'s current lead in technology is, at best, ephemeral.
Related Words: Ephemerally (adverb), ephemerality (noun).

7. Crucible (Noun)
Meaning: A situation of severe trial, leading to the creation of something new.
Hindi: कठिन परीक्षा, अग्निपरीक्षा।
Synonyms: Trial, ordeal, test, gauntlet.
Antonyms: Comfort, ease, sanctuary.
Example: India's start-up economy is a crucible of global innovation.
Related Words: N/A.

8. Edifices (Noun)
Meaning: Large, imposing buildings or complex structures.
Hindi: भव्य इमारतें, विशाल रचनाएँ।
Synonyms: Structures, monuments, buildings.
Antonyms: Huts, shacks, ruins.
Example: The company's machinery was present at all the major edifices built across the country, like the new Parliament.
Related Words: Edifice (singular noun), edify (verb).

9. Strident (Adjective)
Meaning: Loud and harsh; presenting a point of view in an excessively forceful way.
Hindi: कर्कश, तीखा।
Synonyms: Harsh, raucous, shrill, grating.
Antonyms: Soft, gentle, mellow, soothing.
Example: The Turkish President has criticised Israel with strident rhetoric since the start of the war.
Related Words: Stridently (adverb), stridency (noun).

10. Malady (Noun)
Meaning: A disease, ailment, or serious problem.
Hindi: रोग, व्याधि।
Synonyms: Sickness, illness, affliction.
Antonyms: Health, wellness, remedy.
Example: In 2025, a mysterious malady descended on the village of Turakapalem.
Related Words: N/A.

📌 FAZL ALI COMMISSION.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ The creation of Andhra state intensified the demand from other  regions for creation of states on linguistic basis. 

🔸️ This forced the Government of India to appoint (in December, 1953) a three- member States Reorganisation Commission under the chairmanship of Fazl Ali to re-examine the whole question. 

🔸️ Its other two members were K.M. Panikkar and H.N. Kunzru. It submitted its report in September 1955 and broadly accepted language as the basis of reorganisation of states. But, it rejected  the theory of ‘one language-one state’. 

🔸️ Its view was that the unity of India should be regarded as the primary consideration in any redrawing of the country’s political units.

Exam Rise 

1. ओडिसी भारत के ओडिशा राज्य की प्रसिद्ध शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली है।
Odissi is a famous classical dance form of the Indian state of Odisha.

2. पाँचवीं पीढ़ी के कम्प्यूटरों में निर्वात ट्यूब उपलब्ध नहीं होती है।
Vacuum tubes are not available in fifth-generation computers.

3. कम्प्यूटर में जोड़ने, तुलना करने और मिलाने के कार्य CPU चिप में होते हैं।
Addition, comparison, and matching operations in a computer are performed in the CPU chip.

4. ‘मोनालिसा’ का प्रसिद्ध चित्र लियोनार्डो दा विंची ने बनाया था।
The famous painting ‘Mona Lisa’ was created by Leonardo da Vinci.

5. बुला चौधरी पहली महिला थीं जिन्होंने सात प्रमुख सागर तैरकर पार किए।
Bula Choudhury was the first woman to swim across all seven major seas.

6. अमेरिका की खोज क्रिस्टोफर कोलंबस ने की थी।
America was discovered by Christopher Columbus.

7. भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय का आकलन सबसे पहले दादाभाई नौरोजी ने किया था।
National income in India was first estimated by Dadabhai Naoroji.

8. किसी देश का आर्थिक विकास प्राकृतिक संसाधन, पूँजी निर्माण और बाज़ार के आकार पर निर्भर करता है।
The economic development of a country depends on natural resources, capital formation, and market size.

9. राष्ट्रीय आय किसी उत्पादक गतिविधि से निर्मित होती है।
National income is generated through productive activities.

10. मुद्रा-आपूर्ति भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा नियंत्रित की जाती है।
Money supply is controlled by the Reserve Bank of India

📌 J.V.P COMMITTEE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ Dhar commission report created much resentment and led to the appointment of another Linguistic Provinces Committee by the Congress in December, 1948, itself to examine the whole question afresh. 

🔸️ It consisted of Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallahbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya and hence, was popularly known as JVP Committee.

🔸️ It submitted its report in April, 1949, and formally rejected language as the basis for reorganisation of states.

🔸️ However, in October, 1953, the Government of India was forced to create the first linguistic state, known as Andhra state, by separating the Telugu speaking areas from the Madras state. 

🔸️ This followed a prolonged popular agitation and the death of Potti  Sriramulu, a Congress person of standing, after a 56-day hunger strike for the cause.
